summary: Warning! This Pop Puzzle game will make you hungry <3
description:
Enter the realm of sweet tastes with Pop Puzzle. Group jellies of the same shape or color to crush them, score points, solve puzzles and level up in this amazing match 3 game. With addictive match 3 gameplay, tons of challenges, amazing boosters and beautiful graphics, Pop Puzzle will bring you an unforgettable puzzle experience.

You can also spin the toy boosts wheel and win surprises so when ever you get stuck remember you can always use the special boosts and complete the level by just solving the toy block puzzle.

Functions:
• Explore a delightful world filled with delicious treats.
• Match 3 puzzle games with hundreds of levels, each level takes about 2 minutes to complete.
• Casual and relaxing gameplay. Enjoy the world anytime, anywhere.
• Simple and clear rules that create a surprisingly deep gameplay.
• Beautiful illustrations, animation and sound effects.
• Can be played offline, so the fun of jelly chopping never stops.
• Unique boosters bring wild variety and an unforgettable seating experience.
• This is a fantastic yummy jelly puzzle game.

Gameplay:
• Tap 2 or more connected same jellies blocks to blast them.
• Tap 5 connected same jellies blocks to get a Horizontal or Vertical candy .
• Tap 7 connected same jellies blocks to get a Dynamite.
• Tap 7 or more connected same jellies blocks to get a rainbow boom.
• The combination of special jellies will make great and suprise power on the game board.

The game is challenging, it look easy at start to help you learn it but afterwards you will have to think hard and consider your tactics, we promise you that you will have the best time playing and as you progress you will enjoy it more and more, there is nothing better then solving the puzzle blocks and smashing all the cubes.

Whether you love puzzles, match-3 games, or just looking for a game to kill time, Pop Puzzle is a casual game that you can blow your mind into. So what are you waiting for? Join the wonderful match 3 adventure and have fun!
